# GENERATED by tools/regen_ef_fx_deals.py -- do not edit by hand.
# EF.48, night 2 item 3 (2.10): E&F's sell_<currency>_currency_crisis -- the sellers redeem the
# currency for the issuer's metal (at most what it holds) instead of the issuer's metal set to 0.
# !! MAINTENANCE !! Key-level REPLACE_OR_CREATE of E&F's effects: regenerate after an E&F update.

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:sell_dinar_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_dinar_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:sell_eco_ariary_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_eco_ariary_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_eco_ariary_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_eco_ariary_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_eco_ariary_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_eco_ariary_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_eco_ariary_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_eco_ariary_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_eco_ariary_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_eco_ariary_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_franc_belgian_franc_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_franc_belgian_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_franc_belgian_franc_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_franc_belgian_franc_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_franc_belgian_franc_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_franc_belgian_franc_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_franc_belgian_franc_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_franc_belgian_franc_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:sell_franc_french_franc_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_franc_french_franc_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:sell_krone_czech_koruna_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_krone_czech_koruna_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_lira_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_lira_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_lira_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_lira_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_lira_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_lira_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_lira_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_peso_bolivien_peso_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_peso_bolivien_peso_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_peso_bolivien_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_peso_bolivien_peso_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_peso_bolivien_peso_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_peso_bolivien_peso_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_peso_bolivien_peso_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_peso_bolivien_peso_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_peso_bolivien_peso_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

					var:stockpiling_peso_mexican_peso_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_peso_mexican_peso_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_peso_mexican_peso_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_peso_mexican_peso_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_peso_mexican_peso_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_peso_mexican_peso_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:sell_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}

				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_real_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_real_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_real_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_real_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_real_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_real_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_real_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_real_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_real_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:sell_spe_peseta_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_spe_peseta_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_spe_peseta_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_spe_peseta_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_spe_peseta_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}
